variant_decisions.evidence: ASV renders 'him that is mightier than he'. Both readings are the same consonantal root תקף under a relative ש: the qere שֶׁתַּקִּיף and the ketiv שהתקיף differ only in the presence of the ה, and either yields an English relative clause 'that is mightier'. The ASV wording distinguishes neither, and no italicized supply bears on the word. The only ASV note attached here is classed alternative_rendering ('Or, Whatsoever he be, his name was given him long ago...'), which concerns English wording earlier in the verse and never decides a reading; the hebrew_gloss note explains 'man' (Adam), not this lemma. Underdetermined; the qere base fallback carries the projection.
